name: Biting Bracelet
body:
Source Spymaster's Handbook pg. 30
Aura moderate illusion CL 10th
Slot none; Price 5,000 gp; Weight 2 lbs.
Description
This +1 heavy wrist launcherUI appears to be a lavish, gold bracelet. This functions like the glamered weapon special ability (Pathfinder RPG Ultimate Equipment 142), except a biting bracelet is able to only assume this one specific form, and can revert to its innocuous appearance 1 round after being used as a weapon.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, disguise self, magic aura ; Price 2,775 gp
